Atom is a new anonymous communication system that scales horizontally and provides best possible anonymity against active attacks, and is suitable for microblogging and other applications where users send a large number of messages.
Atom is a new system for anonymous messaging that provides "best possible" user-level anonymity against an active adversary, and does so at high throughput, with near-linear scalability.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Atom provides the first system that scales horizontally to large numbers of servers and users while offering the best possible anonymity against a powerful adversary.

strong anonymity does not need to come at the cost of scalability, even in the presence of malicious servers.
